def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])

    c=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    marker=[k for k,v in c.items() if v<=3 and k!=g'some'] 
    # heuristic: pick rarest nonzero as marker
    marker=min(((k,v) for k,v in c.items() if 0<k<v or v==min(v for kk,vv in c.items() if vv>0))[0], key=lambda kv:kv[1])[0]
    fc=max((k for k,v in c.items() if k!=0 and k!=marker), key=c.get)
    ms=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==marker]

    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):
        for j in range(a,b+1):

def solve(I):
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in I for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg]
    barC=max(colors,key=lambda c: sum(r.count(c) for r in I))
    # bar cells
    bar={(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if I[i][j]==barC}
    markers=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if I[i][j] not in (bg,barC)]
    def bars():
        # split into two groups
        rem=set(bar); g=[]
        while rem:
            s={(x,y) for x,y in [(rem.pop(),)] }; comp=set()
            st=list(rem&set(s)|list(s)); rem-=set(st)
            while st:
                c_=st.pop(); comp.add(c_)
                if rem and (rem&[(c_[0]+dx,c_[1]+dy) for dx,dy in [(0,1),(1,0),(-1,0),(0,-1)]]):
                    pass
            g.append(comp)
        return g
        # redo simply
    comps=[]
    vis=set()
    for (i,j) in bar:
        if (i,j) in vis: continue
        stack=[(i,j)]; comp=set()
        while stack:
            c=stack.pop()
            if c in vis: continue
            vis.add(c); comp.add(c)
            for d in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                n=(c[0]+d[0],c[1]+d[1])
                if n in bar and n not in vis: stack.append(n)
        comps.append(comp)
    comps.sort(key=len,reverse=True)
    bar1,bar2=comps
    mset=set(markers)
    moff=None
    # determine marker-aligned bar and offsets
    if bar1:
        br1=sum(p[0] for p in bar1)/len(bar1); brc=sum(p[1] for p in bar1)/len(bar1)
        mr=sum(p[0] for p in mset)/len(mset); mc=sum(p[1] for p in mset)/len(mset)
    elif bar2:
        br1=brc2=br2=brc2=0
        mr,brc=mc=0
        brc1=sum(p[0] for p in bar1)/len(bar1); brc2=sum(p[0] for p in bar2)/len(bar2)
        mc=sum(p[1] for p in mset)/len(mset)
    else:
        return [[I[i][j] for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
    if abs(mc-brc1)<abs(mc-brc2) and len(comps[0])>=len(comps[1]) or True:
        pass
    # pick alignment: marker column within a vertical bar's column span
    vert1=(len(set(i for i,_ in bar1))==1)
    vert2=(len(set(i for i,_ in bar2))==1)
    mb=None

def f(I):
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in I for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg]
    mcol=sorted(colors,key=lambda c: sum(r.count(c) for r in I))[0]
    def comps(cells,color):
        vis=set(); out=[]
        for cell in sorted(cells):
            if cell in vis: continue
            st=[cell]; comp=set()
            while st:
                c=st.pop()
                if c in vis: continue
                vis.add(c); comp.add(c)
                for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    n=(c[0]+dx,c[1]+dy)
                    if 0<=n[0]<h and 0<=n[1]<w and n in {(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if I[i][j]==color} and n not in vis:
                        st.append(n)
            out.append(comp)
        return out
    bcomps=comps({(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if I[i][j]!=bg and I[i][j]!=mcol}, None)
    barC=[c for c in colors if sum(1 for comp in bcomps if c in {I[p[0]][p[1]] for p in comp})>=len(bcomps)/2][0]
    bar={(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if I[i][j]==barC}
    vis=set(); bb=[]
    for cell in sorted(bar):
        if cell in vis: continue
        st=[cell]; comp=set()
        while st:
            c=st.pop()
            if c in vis: continue
            vis.add(c); comp.add(c)
            for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                n=(c[0]+dx,c[1]+dy)
                if n in bar and n not in vis: st.append(n)
        bb.append(comp)
    bb.sort(key=len,reverse=True); B,A=bb
    markers=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if I[i][j]==mcol]
    O=[r[:] for r in I]
    def ray(i,j,di,dj,stop_at=4):
        while True:
            ni,nj=i+di,j+dj
            if not(0<=ni<h and 0<=nj<w): return
            v=O[ni][nj]
            if v==stop_at: return
            if v!=bg: break
            O[ni][nj]=mcol
            i,j=ni,nj
    def vert(b): return len({p[1] for p in b})==1
    def horiz(b): return len({p[0] for p in b})==1
    for b in (A,B):
        if vert(b):
            lo=min(p[0] for p in b); bcol=list({p[1] for p in b})[0]
            off=set(max(0,m[0]-lo) for m in markers)
            mc=sum(m[1] for m in markers)/len(markers)
            dc=1 if mc>bcol else -1
            for off_ in sorted(off):
                ri=lo+off_
                ray(bcol+dc,ri,0,dc,4 if dc*0==0 else 4)
        else:
            lo=min(p[1] for p in b); brow=list({p[0] for p in b})[0]
            off=set(max(0,m[1]-lo) for m in markers)
            mr=sum(m[0] for m in markers)/len(markers)

import os,glob,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def solve(I):
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in I for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    order=sorted([c for c in cnt if c!=bg],key=lambda c:-cnt[c])
    barC,mcol=order[0],order[1]
    def comps(cells):
        vis=set(); out=[]
        for cell in sorted(cells):
            if cell in vis: continue
            st=[cell]; comp=set()
            while st:
                c=st.pop()
                if c in vis: continue
                vis.add(c); comp.add(c)
                for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    n=(c[0]+dx,c[1]+dy)
                    if 0<=n[0]<h and 0<=n[1]<w and n in cells and n not in vis: st.append(n)
            out.append(comp)
        return out
    Cs=comps({(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if I[i][j]==barC})
    Cs.sort(key=len,reverse=True)
    B1,B2=Cs
    def vert(B): return len({p[1] for p in B})==1
    def span1(B):  # along-axis coordinate (row if horiz else col)
        v=vert(B)
        lo=min(p[0] for p in B); hi=max(p[0] for p in B)
        return (lo,hi,v)
    src=None;far=None
    markers=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if I[i][j]==mcol]
    ms=set()
    for m in markers:
        coord = m[0] if vert(B1) else m[1]
        s1,s2=span1(B1),span1(B2)
        if s1[0]<=coord<=s1[1]: src,far=B1,B2
        elif s2[0]<=coord<=s2[1]: src,far=B2,B1
        else:
            # nearest bar by coordinate distance
            d1=min(abs(coord-s1[0])+abs(s1[1]-coord),key=lambda x:x); d2=min(abs(coord-s2[0])+abs(s2[1]-coord),key=lambda x:x)
            if d1<d2: src,far=B1,B2
            else: src,far=B2,B1
    S,F=span1(src),span1(far)
    def ray(i,j,di,dj,O=O):
        while True:
            ni,nj=i+di,j+dj
            if not(0<=ni<h and 0<=nj<w): return
            v=O[ni][nj]
            if v==mcol: O[ni][nj]=4; return
            if v!=bg: break
            O[ni][nj]=mcol
            i,j=ni,nj
    for m in markers:
        coord = m[0] if vert(src) else m[1]
        # src rays at marker coord directly if within src span
        if S[0]<=coord<=S[1]:
            cell = (m[0],m[1]) if vert(src) else (m[0],m[1])
            base = (F[0]+F[1])/2 if False else sum(p[0] for p in far)/len(far) if vert(far) else sum(p[1] for p in far)/len(far)
            # direction: away from src toward far
            dr = 1 if (sum(p[0] for p in far)/len(far)>sum(p[0] for p in src)/len(src)) else -1
            dc = 1 if (sum(p[1] for p in far)/len(far)>sum(p[1] for p in src)/len(src)) else -1
            ray(m[0],m[1],dr,dc)
        rel=coord-S[0]+1
        rel=min(max(rel,0),len(far)-1)
        fc = rel if vert(far) else 0
        rc = coord - rel if vert(far) else 0
        fbase = sum(p[0] for p in far)/len(far) if vert(far) else sum(p[1] for p in far)/len(far)
        fb = int(round(fbase))
        start_row = fb if vert(far) else m[1]
        ray(start_row+fc, start_col if False else (fb if vert(far) else m[1])+rc,
            dr*-1 if False else -dr, dc*-1 if False else -dc, O=O)
    return O

def solve(i):
    h,w=len(i),len(i[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in i for x in r)
    # bars: largest color groups forming straight lines; marker: rarest color
    colors=cnt.most_common()
    barC=colors[0][0]; mk=colors[-1][0]
    # find bar groups: connected components of bar color
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if i[r][c]==barC and (r,c) not in seen:
                st=[(r,c)]; comp=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop()
                    if (a,b) in seen or i[a][b]!=barC: continue
                    seen.add((a,b)); comp.append((a,b))
                    for da in(-1,0,1):
                        for db in(-1,0,1): st.append((a+da,b+db))
                comps.append(comp)
    bars=[sorted(g,key=lambda p:p[0])*1] # will reorder
    bars.sort(key=lambda g:(min(p[0] for p in g), min(p[1] for p in g)))
    marks=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if i[r][c]==mk]
    o=[row[:] for row in i]
    def ext(start,step,length):
        for k in range(length):
            rr=start[0]+step[0]*k; cc=start[1]+step[1]*k
            if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and o[rr][cc]==i[rr][cc]:
                if i[rr][cc]==mk: o[rr][cc]=4
                elif o[rr][cc]!=barC: o[rr][cc]=mk
            else: return
    # determine orientation/alignment of each bar
    infos=[]
    for comp in bars:
        rs=[p[0] for p in comp]; cs=[p[1] for p in comp]
        infos.append({'cells':comp,'h' if len(set(rs))==1 else 'v', 'start'(rs[0] if len(set(cs))>1 else cs[0]), 'end')(max(rs) if len(set(cs))>1 else max(cs))})
    out=[]
    for inf in infos:
        pass
    return o,infos,bars,marks

def diff(k):
    gi,go=G[k+' input'],G[k+' output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # bar color = non-bg color forming run>=2 ; marker color = other non-bg
    def runs():
        out=[]
        for r in range(H):
            c=0
            while c<W:
                if gi[r][c]!=bg:
                    s,c2=gi[r][c],c
                    while c2+1<W and gi[r][c2+1]==s: c2+=1
                    if c2-s+1>=2: out.append((r,s,c2,s))
                    c=c2+1
                else: c+=1
        return out
    B=[b for b in runs() if b[2]-b[1]+1>=2]  # horiz bars
    cols=sorted({b[1] for b in B}); rows=sorted({b[0] for b in B})
    bcols=rows
    mark=Counter(v for r in gi for v in r).most_common()[-1] if False else None
    # marker color: most common non-bg non-bar? just use any cell whose count equals a single isolated pixel... use rarest

    marks=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if gi[r][c]==mcol]
    return gi,go,bg,mcol,B,marks
for k in ['Demo pair %d'%i for i in [1,2,3,4,5]]:

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])

    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # bars: horiz runs>=2 of same non-bg color; bar color = that run color; marker color = other non-bg color(s)
    B=[]
    for r in range(H):
        c=0
        while c<W:
            if g[r][c]!=bg:
                s=g[r][c]; e=c
                while e+1<W and g[r][e+1]==s: e+=1
                if e-c+1>=2: B.append(('h',r,c,e,s))
                c=e+1
            else: c+=1
    barcols=[b[5] for b in B]; markcol=[v for v in set(x for r in g for x in r) if v!=bg and v not in barcols]
    mcol=markcol[0]
    marks=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==mcol]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    # marker cells stay 4
    for r,c in marks: out[r][c]=4
    # for each marker, draw vertical ray from the bar at that column downward/upward until hitting a cell already...

    return out
# Inspect pair6 markers & bars in detail

                if e-c+1>=2: B.append(('h',r,c,e,s))

    print(k,'bars',[b for b in B],'vert',vc)

def f(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    os_=objects(g,bg)
    bars=[comp for col,comp in os_ if len(comp)>=2]; mk=[(col,comp[0]) for col,comp in os_ if len(comp)==1]
    # classify bars: horizontal (single row) vs vertical; group by orientation
    hb=[c for c in bars if len({r for r,_ in c})==1]
    vb=[c for c in bars if len({c for _,c in c})==1]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    def ray(r0,c0,v,col):
        while True:
            y,x=r0+(v>0)-0,x+((1 if v>0 else 0))
            dy,dx=(1 if v>0 else -1,0)
            ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
            if not(0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W): break
            if out[ny][nx]==bg:
                out[ny][nx]=col
            elif out[ny][nx]!=col and gi_orig[ny][nx]!=bg and out[ny][nx]!=4:
                pass
            else:
                break
    return out

def solve(gi):
    g=[row[:] for row in gi]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # find bars: components >=2 cells
    seen=set();bars=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            col=g[r][c]; q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and (ny,nx) not in seen and g[ny][nx]==col:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
            if len(cells)>=2: bars.append(cells)
    # markers: remaining non-bg cells
    mkcells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in set(x for bc in bars for x in bc)]
    mcol=g[mkcells[0][0]][mkcells[0][1]]
    brcol=g[bars[0][0][0]][bars[0][0][1]]
    def isbg(r,c): return 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W and g[r][c]==bg
    def occupied(r,c,val=None): return not(0<=r<H and 0<=c<W) or (g[r][c]!=val) if val else True
    for bar in bars:
        rs=[r for r,_ in bar]; cs=[c for _,c in bar]
        vert = len({r for r,_ in bar})==1 and len(cs)>1   # horizontal bar
        horiz = len({c for _,c in bar})==1 and len(rs)>1
        for (r,c) in bar:
            if vert:  # horizontal bar, vertical rays
                # determine which direction: toward other bar
                oth=[b for b in bars if b is not bar][0]
                orow=sum(1 for (r2,c2) in oth if True)
                orow_r=next(iter({r for r,_ in oth}))
                target = orow_r if orow_r>r else 0  # placeholder
                # choose dir: step toward other bar's centroid row
                oc=[(r2,c2) for r2,c2 in oth]
                ocen=sum(rr for rr,_ in oc)/len(oc)
                d=1 if ocen>r else -1
                rr=r+d
                while 0<=rr<H and g[rr][c]==bg:
                    g[rr][c]=mcol
                    rr+=d
                    # stop at marker
                    if (rr,d*[c][0] if False else c) in mkset: break
            else:
                oc=[(r2,c2) for r2,c2 in oth]
                ocen=sum(cc for _,cc in oc)/len(oc)
                d=1 if ocen>c else -1
                cc_=c+d
                while 0<=cc_<W and g[r][cc_]==bg:
                    g[r][cc_]=mcol
                    cc_+=d
    return g
